mapper.sql: NOTIFICATION_ID AS notificationId, USER_ID AS userId, NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE AS typeCode, TITLE AS title, CONTENT AS content, LINK_URL AS linkUrl, READ_AT AS readAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USER_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, NOTIFICATION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT , COUNT(*) OVER () AS unreadTotal FROM USER_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_AT IS NULL ORDER BY NOTIFICATION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_AT IS NULL
SELECT FROM USER_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_NOTIFICATION SET READ_AT = #{now} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOTIFICATION_ID = #{notificationId} AND READ_AT IS NULL
UPDATE USER_NOTIFICATION SET READ_AT = #{now} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{typeCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{createdAt})
